title: Pure Utopia
summary: Pure Utopia and Onomat Xyz combo deck, piloting Yuma Tsukumo's signature Rank 4 engine into towering Rank 12 bosses, ZW weapon equips, and multi-negate boards. The strategy leverages Onomat pairs, ZS searchers, and continuous draw engines to rank up into Number 99: Utopia Dragonar and Number F0: Utopic Future Zexal.

summary.title: Starters
points: Dodododo Warrior sends Dodododwarf Gogogoglove from Deck to GY to Special Summon itself as a Level 4 monster without using your Normal Summon, and searches Zubababancho Gagagacoat when detached.
Utopic Onomatopoeia counts simultaneously as Zubaba, Gagaga, Gogogo, and Dododo, Special Summoning up to two other Onomat monsters from your hand.

ZS - Ascended Sage Special Summons itself from hand when you control no monsters, and searches any Rank-Up-Magic Normal Spell (Hyper Rank-Up-Magic Utopiforce) when used to Xyz Summon a Utopia monster.
ZS - Armed Sage Special Summons itself if you control only a Level 4 monster, and searches any ZW monster (ZW - Pegasus Twin Saber) when used for a Utopia Xyz Summon.
Onomatopaira sends 1 card from hand to GY to search two different Onomat categories (such as Utopic Onomatopoeia and Dodododo Warrior).
Onomatopickup searches any Onomat card on activation, and modulates the Levels of all Onomat monsters to 4.

summary.title: Opening: Dodododo Warrior + Ascended Sage
steps: Special Summon ZS - Ascended Sage from your hand while controlling no monsters.
Activate Dodododo Warrior in hand, sending Dodododwarf Gogogoglove to the GY to Special Summon itself.
Dodododwarf Gogogoglove triggers in GY, Special Summoning itself because you control Dodododo Warrior.
Overlay Ascended Sage and Dodododo Warrior into Number 39: Utopia; Ascended Sage triggers to search Hyper Rank-Up-Magic Utopiforce, and Dodododo Warrior searches Zubababancho Gagagacoat.
Activate Hyper Rank-Up-Magic Utopiforce on Utopia to rank up into Number 99: Utopia Dragonar.
Dragonar detaches 2 materials to Special Summon Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic Galaxy, while Utopiforce attaches itself from GY to Number 38.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Number 99: Utopia Dragonar detaches 2 materials as a Quick Effect during either turn to cheat out any Number Xyz between 1 and 100 directly from your Extra Deck (such as Number 38 or Ultimate Leo Utopia Ray).

Number F0: Utopic Future Zexal gains 500 ATK/DEF per combined Rank of all Xyz Monsters on field and in opponent's GY, shields other monsters from targeting, and permanently steals control of an opponent monster when they activate an effect.
Number F0: Utopic Draco Future cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects, negates monster effects, and permanently takes control of negated monsters.
Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic Galaxy negates a Spell Card or effect and attaches that card to itself as material.
Ultimate Dragonic Utopia Ray and Ultimate Leo Utopia Ray equip ZW monsters directly from Deck or Extra Deck and negate opposing monster effects.
ZW - Pegasus Twin Saber equips to a Utopia Xyz to boost 1000 ATK and once per turn negates an opponent monster effect activated on the field without starting a chain.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Xyz Change Tactics allows you to pay 500 LP to draw 1 card each time a Utopia monster is Xyz Summoned, drawing 3 to 4 cards in a single turn while lowering LP to enable ZW effects.
Hyper Rank-Up-Magic Utopiforce ranks up a Rank 9 or lower Utopia Xyz into a Rank 10 or higher Utopia/Utopic boss, and attaches itself from GY whenever that boss summons an Xyz.
Double or Nothing! is searched by Number 39: Utopia Double to double Utopia's ATK to 10,000 for an instant one-hit KO.
Numbers Protection is a searchable Counter Trap that negates any Spell, Trap, or monster effect while you control a Number Xyz Monster.

main: Dodododo Warrior

Core 1-card starter (Duelist's Advance): sends 'Dodododwarf Gogogoglove' from your Deck to the GY for cost to Special Summon itself from your hand as a Level 4 monster—and when Gogogoglove revives itself from the GY, you have a 1-card Rank 4 Xyz without using your Normal Summon, plus Dodododo Warrior searches 'Zubababancho Gagagacoat' when detached!
Utopic Onomatopoeia

Core Level 4 LIGHT Warrior: always treated as a 'Zubaba', 'Gagaga', 'Gogogo', AND 'Dododo' card (turning on every Onomat effect simultaneously!); Special Summons up to 2 Zubaba, Gagaga, Gogogo, and/or Dododo monsters of different categories from your hand in Defense Position!
ZS - Ascended Sage

Core Level 4 LIGHT Warrior: Special Summons itself from your hand if you control no monsters; and when used as material to Xyz Summon a 'Utopia' monster, adds ANY 'Rank-Up-Magic' Normal Spell ('Hyper Rank-Up-Magic Utopiforce'!) from your Deck to your hand!
ZS - Armed Sage

Level 4 LIGHT Warrior: Special Summons itself from your hand if the only monster you control is a Level 4 monster (except Armed Sage); and when used as material to Xyz Summon a 'Utopia' monster, adds ANY 'ZW -' monster ('ZW - Pegasus Twin Saber'!) from your Deck to your hand!
Astraltopia

Level 4 LIGHT Warrior: Special Summons itself from your hand if there is an Xyz Monster on the field, and sends 1 other card from your hand or field to the GY to add 'Xyz Change Tactics', 'Onomatopickup', 'Zexal Construction', or 'Numbers Protection' from your Deck to your hand!
Zubababancho Gagagacoat

Level 4 EARTH Warrior (searched when Dodododo Warrior is detached!): Special Summons itself from your hand while you control Utopic Onomatopoeia or Gagagaga Girl, and revives Dodododwarf Gogogoglove or Utopic Onomatopoeia from your GY!
Dodododwarf Gogogoglove

Level 4 EARTH Rock (sent from Deck to GY by Dodododo Warrior!): revives itself from your GY in Defense Position while you control Dodododo Warrior or Utopic Onomatopoeia, and Special Summons a Zubaba/Gagaga from your hand!
ZW - Pegasus Twin Saber

Level 5 LIGHT Beast (searched by ZS - Armed Sage or Ultimate Dragonic Utopia Ray!): Special Summons itself if your LP are 2000+ lower (easily paid via Xyz Change Tactics!), equips to a Utopia Xyz for +1000 ATK, and once per turn negates an opponent's monster effect activated on the field WITHOUT starting a Chain!
Onomatopickup
Core Continuous Spell (searchable by Gagagaga Girl and Astraltopia!): adds ANY 'Onomat' card ('Onomatopaira' or 'Utopic Onomatopoeia'!) from your Deck to your hand on activation!
Onomatopaira

Core Normal Spell: sends 1 card from your hand to the GY to add up to 2 monsters among 'Zubaba', 'Gagaga', 'Gogogo', and/or 'Dododo' (up to 1 from each category: Utopic Onomatopoeia + Dodododo Warrior / Zubababancho!) from your Deck to your hand!
Zexal Construction
Normal Spell: reveals 1 card in your hand and shuffles it into the Deck to add ANY 'ZW -', 'ZS -', 'Zexal', or 'Rank-Up-Magic' card from your Deck to your hand!
Hyper Rank-Up-Magic Utopiforce

Core Rank-Up-Magic Normal Spell (searched by ZS - Ascended Sage!): targets 1 Rank 9 or lower 'Utopia' Xyz Monster you control and Xyz Summons 1 Rank 10 or higher 'Utopia' or 'Utopic' Xyz Monster ('Number 99: Utopia Dragonar'!) over it; and whenever a Rank 10+ Utopia/Utopic Xyz (Dragonar) Special Summons an Xyz Monster, attaches itself from your GY to that summoned Xyz as material!
Xyz Change Tactics

Signature Continuous Spell (searchable by Astraltopia and Gagagaga Girl!): every time a 'Utopia' monster is Xyz Summoned to your field, you can pay 500 LP to draw 1 card (not once per turn—drawing 3 to 4 cards across Utopia Double, Utopia, Dragonar, and Lightning while lowering your LP by 2000 to unlock ZW - Pegasus Twin Saber!)!
Double or Nothing!
Quick-Play Spell searched from your Deck by Number 39: Utopia Double to double Utopia's ATK to 10,000 for an instant 1-hit KO!
Reinforcement of the Army
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches ZS - Ascended Sage, ZS - Armed Sage, or Utopic Onomatopoeia.
Numbers Protection
Signature Counter Trap (searchable by Astraltopia!): when a Spell/Trap Card or monster effect is activated while you control a 'Number' Xyz Monster, negates the activation and destroys that card!
extra: Number 99: Utopia Dragonar

Signature Rank 12 LIGHT Warrior Xyz boss (summoned over Number 39: Utopia via Hyper Rank-Up-Magic Utopiforce; 3000 ATK): once per turn during EITHER player's turn (Quick Effect), detaches 2 materials to Special Summon ANY 'Number' monster between Number 1 and Number 100 from your Extra Deck (treated as an Xyz Summon—summoning Number 38: Hope Harbinger on your turn and Ultimate Leo Utopia Ray on the opponent's turn while Utopiforce attaches itself from your GY!)!
Number F0: Utopic Future Zexal

Signature Rank 1 LIGHT Warrior Xyz boss (Duelist's Advance; summoned using 2 Xyz Monsters with the same Rank, such as Rank 4 Gagagaga Girl + Rank 4 ZS - Utopic Sage!): gains 500 ATK/DEF for the combined Ranks of all Xyz Monsters you control and in your opponent's GY (4000–6000+ ATK alongside Rank 12 Dragonar and Rank 8 Number 38!), prevents your opponent from targeting other monsters with attacks or card effects, AND detaches 1 material when your opponent activates a card/effect on the field (Quick Effect) to permanently steal control of 1 monster they control and become indestructible this turn!
Gagagaga Girl

Rank 4 DARK Spellcaster Xyz (Duelist's Advance; 2 Level 4 monsters): detaches 1 material (triggering Dodododo Warrior!) to add ANY 'Gagaga', 'Onomat', or 'Xyz' card (Onomatopickup, Onomatopaira, or Xyz Change Tactics!) from your Deck to your hand, and overlays with ZS - Utopic Sage into Number F0: Utopic Future Zexal to grant it 2 attacks!
ZS - Utopic Sage

Rank 4 LIGHT Warrior Xyz (2 Level 4 monsters): detaches 2 materials to Special Summon any 'ZS -' or 'Utopic' monster directly from your Deck, then overlays with Gagagaga Girl into Number F0: Utopic Future Zexal!
Number 39: Utopia Double

Rank 4 LIGHT Warrior Xyz (2 Level 4 monsters): detaches 1 material as a Quick Effect to add 'Double or Nothing!' from your Deck to your hand, then Xyz Summons 'Number 39: Utopia' over itself with doubled original ATK (5000 ATK -> 10,000 ATK with Double or Nothing!)!
Number 39: Utopia

Yuma's iconic Rank 4 LIGHT Warrior Xyz (2500 ATK): negates attacks (triggering Double or Nothing! for 10,000 ATK), ranks up into Number 99: Utopia Dragonar via Utopiforce, or stacks into Utopia the Lightning / Ultimate Dragonic Utopia Ray.
Ultimate Dragonic Utopia Ray

Rank 5 LIGHT Warrior Xyz (also always treated as 'Number C39: Utopia Ray'): equips a 'ZW -' monster directly from your Deck or Extra Deck when targeted, and detaches 1 material once per turn to negate face-up cards your opponent controls up to the number of ZW cards equipped to it!
Number S39: Utopia the Lightning

Rank 5 LIGHT Warrior Xyz stacked over Number 39: Utopia: prevents your opponent from activating cards or effects when it battles and detaches 2 materials to make its ATK become 5000 during damage calculation!
Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic Galaxy
Rank 8 Dragon 'Number' Xyz cheated out by Number 99: Utopia Dragonar (and given Utopiforce from your GY as Xyz Material!) to negate Spell activations.
Number F0: Utopic Future
Rank 0 Xyz (2 non-Number Xyz with the same Rank) that upgrades into Utopic Draco Future.
Number F0: Utopic Draco Future
Rank 0 Xyz boss stacked over Utopic Future that cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects and detaches 1 material to negate a monster effect and steal that monster.
Ultimate Leo Utopia Ray
Rank 5: always treated as Number C39: Utopia Ray, equips ZW monsters directly from Deck/Extra Deck and negates opponent's monster effects.
